mainEntity.name: What is the process for filing a medical negligence claim?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process typically begins with an initial consultation where a lawyer evaluates the details of your potential case. If accepted, the lawyer will conduct a thorough investigation, gathering medical records, consulting with medical experts, and assessing the viability of the claim. This is followed by filing a formal complaint, engaging in discovery (exchanging information with the defense), and often attempting mediation or settlement negotiations. If a settlement cannot be reached, the case may proceed to trial. The duration can vary significantly depending on the complexity of the case.
acceptedAnswer.description: Filing a claim involves an initial consultation, thorough investigation, filing a complaint, discovery, and potential settlement negotiations or trial. The process length varies.
